[Date]

Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield  
Appeals Department  
[Appeals address or submission route provided by Anthem]

Re: Appeal of prior authorization denial  
Member: Rowan Ellison  
Member ID: W869972825  
Reference number: POC-CE2E11F72D-11045  
Requested service: Arthroscopic rotator cuff repair  
CPT: 29827  
Date of denial notice: August 4, 2026

To the Appeals Department:

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for CPT 29827, rotator cuff repair. The denial states that the submitted documentation was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity.

The clinical record supports the medical necessity of the requested surgery:

- I have had nine months of progressive shoulder pain that has not been relieved by rest.
- I completed 18 supervised physical therapy visits over 10 weeks, from April 9, 2026, through June 18, 2026. Therapy focused on rotator cuff strengthening and scapular mechanics. The physical therapy discharge note documents completion of this treatment.
- I used NSAIDs for six months without adequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on April 9, 2026, provided only four weeks of partial relief.
- MRI performed on May 27, 2026, demonstrated a 1.8-cm full-thickness supraspinatus tear with grade 2 fatty atrophy.
- Function remains substantially impaired: I cannot lift the affected arm above shoulder height and cannot sleep on the affected side.
- Examination showed positive provocative testing on the affected side, with range of motion limited by pain.
- There is no active infection or untreated substance use. My BMI is 29, and I am a non-smoker.
- The treating surgeon, Reyes, MD, is an orthopedic surgeon.

This documentation establishes a persistent symptomatic full-thickness rotator cuff tear, substantial functional limitation, objective MRI findings, abnormal examination findings, and inadequate response to medication, injection, and supervised physical therapy. The record therefore provides the clinical information needed to evaluate medical necessity.

The specific governing Anthem medical policy or clinical review criteria applied to this case were not identified in the denial notice, and the plan has not been quoted in this appeal. Please identify the exact policy or criteria used, including the title, policy number, version, effective date, and any documentation requirements that were allegedly unmet. Please also provide the clinical-review rationale explaining what information was missing.

If Anthem believes any additional information is required, please identify each missing item specifically and allow the treating surgeon an opportunity to submit it or participate in a peer-to-peer review. Please associate the enclosed records with reference number POC-CE2E11F72D-11045 and reconsider the denial based on the complete clinical record.

I request authorization for CPT 29827. If this appeal is not approved, please provide a detailed written explanation addressing each clinical record listed above and the exact criteria used in making the determination.

This appeal is submitted before the January 31, 2027 deadline stated in the denial notice.

Sincerely,

Rowan Ellison  
[Mailing address]  
[Telephone number]  
[Email address]

Enclosures:

- Denial notice dated August 4, 2026
- MRI report dated May 27, 2026
- Physical therapy discharge note documenting 18 visits from April 9, 2026, through June 18, 2026
- Medication and treatment history
- Corticosteroid injection record dated April 9, 2026
- Orthopedic examination and clinical notes from Reyes, MD
- Prior authorization submission and supporting records
